name: Sendcloud
summary: European e-commerce shipping platform: connect 160+ carriers, print labels in batches, show delivery options at checkout, send branded tracking (email, WhatsApp, SMS) and run a self-service returns portal, with rules-based shipping automation. Available to online retailers in 8 countries (Netherlands, Belgium, UK, France, Germany, Austria, Italy, Spain). Free plan available.
best_for: European e-commerce stores that want easy multi-carrier shipping (DHL, PostNL, Colissimo, GLS, DPD), branded tracking and a returns portal live in under 30 minutes
skip_if: you ship mainly in the US, need inventory management and complex fulfilment, or you're a very high-volume shipper wanting deep customisation: ShipStation fits that better
honest_knock: The pricing has layers: a per-label fee on top of the subscription, plus carrier surcharges that can land on invoices weeks later. It's built out-of-the-box, so deep customisation is limited, there's no inventory management (ShipStation has it), and high-volume shippers (€12k+/mo) plus pickup-reliability complaints suggest it's happiest with small-to-mid EU stores.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-11-23 against the vendor's own pricing page, read from our EU server; every figure below matched the 2026-11-17 reading, including the carrier rates; earlier readings 2026-09-22 from a Dutch exit and 31 Aug 2026; subscriptions, label fees, caps, users and integrations identical across all of them; three carrier rates moved between September and November, see below) Free plan €0/mo: up to 20 parcels a month, no courier contract, no subscription; on 22 Sep 2026 the comparison table gave €0.50 a label beyond that, but on 17 Nov 2026 it no longer printed a free-plan label fee and the FAQ says only that free users are billed for each label they generate. Paid tiers at the monthly rate: Lite €28/mo + €0.10 per label, Growth €87/mo + €0.09, Premium €175/mo + €0.08, Pro €639/mo + €0.07. Every tier also has a MONTHLY label cap (Lite 400, Growth 1,000, Premium 10,000, Pro 30,000) and past it each extra label costs €0.15 on top of the plan rate; the same caps appear as yearly maxima on the plan cards (4,800 / 12,000 / 120,000 / 360,000 labels a year). Users: 1 free, 3 Lite, 5 Growth, 10 Premium, unlimited Pro. Integrations: max 2 free, 3 Lite, 5 Growth, unlimited on Premium and Pro. Carriers: 70+ on free, 170+ on every paid tier. 14-day free trial, no card. The page advertises a yearly option at -20% but the discounted figures are not in the served HTML. You can only ship FROM eight European countries (Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, the UK). THE CARRIER RATE TABLE, first recorded 22 Sep 2026 and the part that actually moves the bill: the plans buy a carrier discount the feature table grades '- / + / ++ / +++ / ++++', and the starting rates are published per plan. PostNL Standaard €7.20 free, €6.95 Lite, €6.75 Growth, €6.60 Premium, 'On request' on Pro. DHLForYou Drop off €6.12 / 5.82 / 5.56 / 5.45 / On request (read 17 Nov 2026; €5.80 / 5.50 / 5.25 / 5.14 on 22 Sep). DPD Home €6.09 / 5.88 / 5.75 / 5.62 / On request (17 Nov; €5.82 / 5.61 / 5.48 / 5.35 on 22 Sep). PostNL did not move. So the per-parcel discount steps (€0.20 and €0.15 between the paid tiers on PostNL) are fifteen to twenty times the one-cent steps in the label fee. The three UK carriers are priced on the FREE column only - Royal Mail Tracked 48 £2.62 (17 Nov 2026; £2.38 on 22 Sep), Evri Standard Two Day £3.37, FedEx Priority £5.15 - with 'On request' across Lite, Growth, Premium and Pro. Pro publishes no rate for any carrier at all, so the €639 tier cannot be modelled from this page. The table is footnoted 'Prices shown are starting rates. Actual costs may vary. Create a free account to view all rates', and its row-label column header is still literally 'Placeholder'. (2026)
